content_text: I think Max answers well. I would hope to shoot on a cloudy day as dappled sunlight could kill the look you seem to be after. That is unless you would be OK with a moonlight effect. I have shot ‘day for night’ in a jungle under a full sun, which looked quite good if I managed to keep the sky out of frame.
